part.text:
Fixed. The regression from #5540 ("Track import name instead of modifying filename") stopped modifying tokens' `File` when splicing imported tokens, so line comparisons between an outer-file token and a spliced snippet token (e.g. `{` at line 10 vs `import` at line 6 from the snippet) wrongly concluded they were on the same line — preventing `directive()` from processing the nested `import`.

The fix (mirroring upstream PR #5626, minus test files):
- `caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go`: added `isNextOnNewLine(t1, t2)` which compares files, **import chains** (`imports` slices), and line numbers.
- `caddyconfig/caddyfile/dispenser.go`: `isNewLine`, `isNextOnNewLine`, `nextOnSameLine`, and `NextLine` now all delegate to that helper.
- `caddyconfig/caddyfile/parse.go:597`: snippet-detection in `doImport` uses the same helper.

`TestNestedImport` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes, and all `caddyconfig/caddyfile` + `caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile` tests pass with `-count=1`; `go vet` is clean. The `modules/caddyhttp` test failure is a pre-existing environment issue (no network to fetch test-only deps), unrelated to this change.
